items.title: For a proper flat morphism with geometrically reduced fibre the pushforward splits off a finite etale algebra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 67 行、四段：①用 cohomology and base change 把推前 O_X 认成 perfect 且与任意基变换交换，从而 tor amplitude 从 0 起有下界；②声称（并局部化后实现）H^0 与 τ_{≥1} 的直和分解、后者 tor amplitude ≥1；③由「perfect + 平坦 ⇒ 有限局部自由」与「纤维 H^0 的维数 = 几何既约纤维的连通分支数」定出秩，再用维数函数的半连续性把条件保持到邻域；④用「纤维上的幂等元来自推前」把 H^0 认成有限 étale 代数。承重步骤（基变换、分解、分支数、幂等元）都在 span 内；9 处引用（3 同章、6 跨章）作导航桩。注：作者建议读者先读同章的 proper-flat-h0，但本卡的推演是自足写出的。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-proper-flat-geom-red (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 8399-8412

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the cohomology and base change input making the pushforward perfect, the local splitting off of the degree zero cohomology with a perfect complement, and the identification of that cohomology with a finite etale algebra using the idempotents on the fibre and the semicontinuity of the dimension function (source lines 8414-8480)
